reasons: Lake treatment.field_i_validity is good_law and varies_by_point is false, matching the inventory payload.
But treatment provenance says the validity source is migration plus page frontmatter, and the lake derivation separately flags audit_needed true with proposed_negative_events.

The treatment.edges list includes proposed negative labels including overruled, abrogated, criticized, questioned, and superseded_by_statute, all with field_iii mentioned; that does not itself prove Martinez-Fuerte is no longer good law, but it refutes the page's certainty that no negative treatment was identified.
residual_risks: Because the edges are proposed and marked mentioned, disclosed evidence does not prove an actual overruling or abrogation of Martinez-Fuerte.
A final treatment audit is needed to decide whether any candidate edge should become a real point override or downgrade.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Status: good_law per current lake judgment as of 2026-06-30; proposed negative-treatment candidates exist and R15 audit is pending; no confirmed point override in this record.
